message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" is presented in grayscale with a red vertical border on the left and a red horizontal bar at the bottom. The large title "TEMPO" is centered at the top in a gray serif font, with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. At the top left, text reads "MODUS BARU MOBIL MEWAH ILEGAL", and at the top right, "LESU DARAH DAERAH PRODUSEN BATU BARA".

The central image shows five people standing outdoors in a camp setting. Four face forward and one is turned away to the right. They all wear dark niqabs and layered clothing; three wear spectacles. One individual on the left has a white shawl draped over their shoulders. One wears a dark baseball cap with a circular logo on top of their head covering. The people stand close together on light-colored, rocky ground. In the background, numerous white tents and structures are visible.

The main headline reads "PARA PENGEJAR MIMPI ISIS" in bold white capital letters. Smaller white and red text below describes "ratusan mantan kombatan Negara Islam Irak dan Suriah asal Indonesia dan keluarganya" in various locations. A barcode and price information "17-23 JUNI 2019" are at the bottom right.
